subject: literacy
concept: Writing a simple informational piece describing facts about a topic
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts fact cards about a topic from fiction/opinion cards before writing
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a written fact to the correct topic picture
exercise.abstract: Student writes 3-4 factual sentences describing a chosen topic

assessment.mastery_threshold: writes at least 3 accurate, on-topic factual sentences
misconception_flags: mixes in a made-up or opinion-based sentence within a factual piece

interest_binding: topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
